title: gate task image manifest v1
description: Single declaration of a bootable task image, shipped by the image producer next to the unified Incus tarball (image.tar.gz). Gate identifies an image build by this file's presence and kind, validates it fail-closed in prov_load_manifest, and translates it into incus init flags. Unknown kind refuses, and v1 readers refuse unknown top-level keys (so a v2-shaped manifest can never be half-read); the producer module may carry more options than v1 serializes. v1 is share-free: the agent carries control and files, so shares must be empty. Static IPs on one shared subnet: each role address runs once at a time — the host refuses IP overlap across live holders, which bounds per-role concurrency until per-run networks (v2) remove the limit.

kind.description: Manifest contract version. Anything else refuses.

role.description: Instance role. Instance names embed it as gate-<run>-<role>; the suite addresses it as the role.

vcpu.description: Guest vcpus, checked against the host max-vcpu ceiling at launch.

memMb.description: Guest memory in MiB, checked against the host max-mem ceiling at launch.

mac.description: Guest NIC hardware address on the managed bridge.

ip.description: Guest static address with /24 suffix. Must sit inside the managed bridge's prefix; host octets 2-254.

shares.description: Host shares. v1 forbids them: non-empty refuses.
